question: Does PPO reduce net execution cost relative to simulator-fitted Almgren-Chriss?
holdout_rule: Download and integrity verification allowed; no feature extraction or inspection until simulator fit and gates are frozen. Evaluate once, retain failures, no refit on validation or holdout.
availability_rule: If a registered date is unavailable, record the HTTP/network failure; do not silently substitute an observed date or call old data a fresh holdout.
mapping: Normalize native aggregate depth and price using training-only instrument-specific scales. Simulated lots are normalized units, not derivative contracts or shares.
impact_limit: Visible-book walk curve is a liquidity proxy, not identified causal permanent market impact.
stopping_rule: Fixed compute budget, no final-test checkpoint selection; report possible undertraining.
module_scope: Freeze portfolio/FX and new product modules. Focus on execution research.
